rebecca-sales: FYI customer (GlobalInsure) needs a 2-week EU-only POC. Must provide: signed subprocessors list, routing path diagram proving no cross-border egress, BYO-KMS pricing line, and hosted vs dedicated delta. Can we triage?

vikram-ops: We support tenant pinning to eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1. Subprocessors: AWS (EC2/S3), Fastly (edge), Sentry (errors), Datadog (metrics). I can export the list + SOC2/ISO links.
vikram-ops: Sample enforcement config we can share:
```json
{"tenant":"globalinsure-poc","region_pin":"eu-central-1","geofence":true,"fallback":"none"}
```
tony-se: Pricing note for quote: hosted short POC estimate includes egress premium ~€0.035/token; Dedicated reserved shows egress ~€0.009/token but needs commit. BYO-KMS: setup €1,800 + per-token fee €0.011. I'll add numbers to the quote doc.
olga-legal: I can sign the attestation once Sales attaches the subproc export and the technical routing statement from Ops. Need liability lines for BYO-KMS.
